coverage.fixture_note: Trimmed test fixture derived from the owner's research pack; counts below describe the ORIGINAL run, not this excerpt.
known_limitations: The run is capped at the first 15 entities in APRA's 67-entry Australian-owned ADI section; it is not a complete Australian credit-card market census.
The APRA ADI register is a legal-entity frame, not a complete register of every non-bank card issuer or distributor; later issuer/register positions and non-ADI licensees require separate batches.
A standards-compliant Consumer Data Right discovery and product API response could not be retrieved in the execution environment, so no product was marked verified solely from a structured feed.
ASIC's interactive/open-data credit-licensee rows were not exported; provider register IDs are provider-declared unless explicitly stated otherwise.

ANZ's mutable fees-document URL rendered different publication dates in separate retrieval paths (27 March 2026 in the visual render and 25 August 2026 in parsed text); no single product effective date was assigned.
Australian Military Bank's product page says the 12-month balance transfer reverts to 11.99%, while its key facts sheet says the cash-advance rate of 19.99% applies; the product is unverified.
Qudos Bank's current rate page displays standard rates of 12.34%, 15.85% and 18.99%, while its footnote labels 12.84%, 16.35% and 19.49% as current; all three Qudos products are unverified.

Beyond Bank's product page carries a rates-current date of 8 December 2020, while its key facts sheet is correct as at 1 October 2024; the newer mandated disclosure date was used and the discrepancy retained.
BNK and Cairns Bank exclusions are based on review of current first-party product/disclosure routes and are not express no-card declarations.

BOQ-branded cards were excluded from Bank of Queensland Limited because the reviewed first-party disclosure identifies National Australia Bank Limited as issuer; brand and distributor were not conflated with legal issuer.
Qudos Bank products are counted under Bank Australia Limited because APRA lists Qudos Bank as its current trading name and the provider identifies Bank Australia Limited as issuer.
The catalog counts marketed product families, not card artwork, temporary acquisition offers, additional-cardholder records or historical/closed variants.
Rates, fees and promotions can change after retrieval; promotional periods and conditions are included only where the provider stated them.
